title: Evaluate the Bracket Pairs of a String
summary: Given a string containing bracket pairs with keys and a 2D array of known key-value pairs, replace each key within a bracket pair with its corresponding value if the key is known.
statement: Given a string containing bracket pairs with keys and a 2D array of known key-value pairs, replace each key within a bracket pair with its corresponding value if the key is known. If a key is unknown, replace the key and its bracket pair with a question mark. Ensure that there are no nested brackets, and each key appears only once in the string.
constraints: Bracketed keys are nonempty and brackets never nest.
Replace known keys with their values and unknown keys with a single question mark.
hints: A dictionary gives constant-time lookup for each bracketed key.
Scan the string; copy ordinary characters and jump from an opening bracket to its closing bracket.
Non-nesting guarantees each jump captures one complete key, and every input position is copied or replaced exactly once.
editorial: Non-nesting guarantees each jump captures one complete key, and every input position is copied or replaced exactly once.

tests.explanation: The unknown key name becomes a question mark, producing hi?.
